news.title: Americans’ views of Israelis have grown increasingly negative, but views of Palestinians have held fairly steady
news.summary_en: Americans’ views of the Israeli people and government have grown more negative across party lines and age groups, while opinions of Palestinians have held largely steady.

news.title: U.S. Hispanics Are Divided on Whether Their Identity Helps or Hurts Them in America
news.summary_en: Some say being Latino is a source of advantage or connection but others say it is tied to barriers and discrimination.
